<thought>Search for a template that matches the intramolecular Michael cyclization of a chalcone to a flavanone. Use a representative flavanone SMILES as the target and specify the functional groups formed/broken and bond changes described.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C(O)C2=CC=CC=C2O1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
